elements.name: Physical
elements.desc: No element: steady damage that nothing resists.

elements.name: Fire
elements.desc: Sets enemies on fire: extra damage over 3 seconds. Strong against ice.

elements.name: Ice
elements.desc: Chills and slows enemies; chill them enough and they freeze solid. Strong against fire.

elements.name: Lightning
elements.desc: Shocks enemies so they take 20% more damage from everything.

elements.name: Poison
elements.desc: Poison stacks up to 5 times and eats away at tough enemies.

elements.name: Bleed
elements.desc: Bleeding stacks up to 3 times: big damage over time.

elements.name: Void
elements.desc: Tears rifts: damage over time and a slow. Strong against holy.

elements.name: Earth
elements.desc: Staggers enemies for a moment (a short stun).

elements.name: Wind
elements.desc: Knocks enemies back, keeping them away from you.

elements.name: Holy
elements.desc: Smites for 25% bonus damage. Strong against void.

elements.name: Arcane
elements.desc: Marks enemies: your next hit on a marked enemy is a sure critical.

materials.name: Bronze
materials.desc: Light: a little faster, a little weaker.

materials.name: Bone
materials.desc: Light and sharp, with a taste for blood.

materials.name: Yew
materials.desc: Springy wood: a bit better at everything, with longer reach.

materials.name: Obsidian
materials.desc: Heavy volcanic glass: hits hard but swings slower.

materials.name: Crystal
materials.desc: Quick and keen, humming with frost and magic.

materials.name: Mythril
materials.desc: Light and strong: more damage and more speed.

materials.name: Dragonscale
materials.desc: Big damage and big crits, warm to the touch.

materials.name: Monster Fang
materials.desc: Wicked edges that find weak spots.

materials.name: Ancient
materials.desc: The heaviest hitter: long reach, slow swings.

materials.name: Shadowsteel
materials.desc: Forged in the dark: damage, speed and crits.

effects.name: Flame Arc
effects.desc: Attacks launch a fire projectile.

effects.name: Thunder Strike
effects.desc: Hits arc lightning to nearby enemies.

effects.name: Blood Feast
effects.desc: Part of the damage restores Health; kills heal more.

effects.name: Void Edge
effects.desc: Attacks can open small portals that pull enemies in.

effects.name: Frost Nova
effects.desc: Every 4th attack releases a freezing nova.

effects.name: Plague Bloom
effects.desc: Kills leave a lingering poison cloud.

effects.name: Ricochet
effects.desc: Projectiles bounce to another enemy.

effects.name: Echo Strike
effects.desc: Attacks may echo a moment later as a phantom.

effects.name: Whirlwind
effects.desc: Every 3rd attack becomes a spinning slash.

effects.name: Gale
effects.desc: Attacks send out a wind wave that knocks enemies back.

effects.name: Earthsplitter
effects.desc: Every 2nd attack raises a line of stone spikes.

effects.name: Phantom Blades
effects.desc: Attacks conjure homing spectral blades.

effects.name: Judgement
effects.desc: Critical hits call down a pillar of light.

effects.name: Critical Detonation
effects.desc: Critical hits explode.

effects.name: Phase Strike
effects.desc: Attacks teleport you to your target.

effects.name: Soul Harvest
effects.desc: Kills grant a short attack speed frenzy.

effects.name: Rending Strikes
effects.desc: Critical hits tear open bleeding wounds.

effects.name: Hunter's Mark
effects.desc: Critical hits mark the target: your next hit on it is a guaranteed critical.

effects.name: Shockwave
effects.desc: Every 3rd attack sends out a shockwave that knocks enemies back.

effects.name: Adrenaline
effects.desc: Kills grant a burst of movement speed.

effects.name: Fan of Blades
effects.desc: Every 4th attack also throws a fan of knives.

effects.name: Lava Burst
effects.desc: Attacks hurl lava that leaves burning pools.

effects.name: Permafrost
effects.desc: Chilled enemies shatter into ice shards when killed.

effects.name: Tempest
effects.desc: Hits may call down lightning strikes.

effects.name: Singularity
effects.desc: Kills collapse into small black holes.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.desc: Calls down a meteor on the target area.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Teleport forward, damaging enemies where you land.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.desc: Creates an area that pulls enemies in.

abilities.name: Clone
abilities.desc: Creates a copy of you that fights alongside you.

abilities.name: Phoenix
abilities.desc: Erupts in flame. While ready, revives you once on death.

abilities.name: Time Warp
abilities.desc: Slows enemies in a large area.

legendaryAbilities.name: Starfall
legendaryAbilities.desc: Stars rain down on the enemies around you and burst in blinding light.

legendaryAbilities.name: Dragon's Breath
legendaryAbilities.desc: Breathe a roaring cone of dragonfire that follows your aim and leaves the ground burning.

legendaryAbilities.name: Absolute Zero
legendaryAbilities.desc: A blizzard whirls around you, slowing everything in it, then freezes it solid and shatters it.

legendaryAbilities.name: Wrath of Storms
legendaryAbilities.desc: Three waves of lightning leap from enemy to enemy, shocking all they touch.

legendaryAbilities.name: Event Horizon
legendaryAbilities.desc: Open a singularity that drags enemies in, then collapses in a devastating blast.

legendaryAbilities.name: Thousand Blades
legendaryAbilities.desc: Conjure a halo of spectral blades that hunt enemies down one after another.

legendaryAbilities.name: Venom Bloom
legendaryAbilities.desc: A giant flower bursts from the ground and pulses waves of venom for several seconds.

legendaryAbilities.name: Ascension
legendaryAbilities.desc: Rise as an avatar of power: much stronger and faster, and every strike sends out a shockwave.

components.name: Fire Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Fire weapons.

components.name: Ice Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Ice weapons.

components.name: Lightning Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Lightning weapons.

components.name: Poison Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Poison weapons.

components.name: Blood Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Bleed weapons.

components.name: Earth Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Earth weapons.

components.name: Wind Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Wind weapons.

components.name: Holy Core
components.desc: Lets the forge craft Holy weapons.

components.name: Void Core
components.desc: Void weapons, Void Edge, Phase Strike and the Soul Lantern.

components.name: Arcane Core
components.desc: Arcane weapons, Phantom Blades and the Clone ability.

components.name: Monster Fang
components.desc: A serrated material. Also teaches the Whip.

components.name: Dragon Scale
components.desc: Dragonscale material and Critical Detonation.

components.name: Crystal Heart
components.desc: Crystal material and the Magic Orb.

components.name: Ancient Blade
components.desc: Ancient material, the Greatsword and Whirlwind.

components.name: Obsidian Shard
components.desc: Heavy volcanic glass.

components.name: Mythril Ore
components.desc: Light and fast Mythril.

components.name: Shadow Ingot
components.desc: Shadowsteel for fast, cruel weapons.

components.name: Blueprint: Scythe
components.desc: Teaches the Scythe.

components.name: Blueprint: Crossbow
components.desc: Teaches the Crossbow.

components.name: Blueprint: Gun
components.desc: Teaches the Gun.

components.name: Blueprint: Cannon
components.desc: Teaches the Cannon.

components.name: Blueprint: Chakram
components.desc: Teaches the Chakram.

components.name: Blueprint: Warfan
components.desc: Teaches the exotic Warfan.

components.name: Inferno Core
components.desc: Boss core. Lava Burst, the Phoenix ability and fierce fire weapons.

components.name: Glacial Heart
components.desc: Boss core. Permafrost and unbreakable ice weapons.

components.name: Storm Heart
components.desc: Boss core. Tempest and roaring storm weapons.

components.name: Abyssal Crown
components.desc: Boss core. Singularity and the Black Hole ability.

components.name: Bone Crown
components.desc: Boss core. Savage bleeding weapons fit for a king of the dead.

components.name: Heartwood
components.desc: Boss core. Weapons that drip with the forest's venom.

components.name: Wyrm Fang
components.desc: Boss core. Heavy, staggering earth weapons.

components.name: Tide Pearl
components.desc: Boss core. Cold, crashing weapons of the deep sea.

buildings.name: Hearth
buildings.desc: The heart of your camp. Rest here to heal; every upgrade makes you tougher.

buildings.name: Forge
buildings.desc: Craft weapons and pickaxes. Upgrades make crafting cheaper, crafted weapons stronger and unlock better catalysts and tools.

buildings.name: Vault
buildings.desc: Your stash. Every upgrade adds storage slots and a bigger bag.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.desc: Study weapon components. Every upgrade makes research cheaper.

buildings.name: Training Grounds
buildings.desc: Drill every day. Every upgrade adds Attack Power and Defense.

buildings.name: Essence Well
buildings.desc: Draws essence from the ground, even while you are away. Come back and collect it.

buildings.name: Pal Den
buildings.desc: A cosy nest for pals. Hatch pal eggs here; every upgrade lets your pals grow two levels stronger.

buildings.name: Waystone
buildings.desc: Level 1: recall to camp from anywhere. Level 2: step back through to where you left.

pickaxes.name: Steel Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: Faster, and mines the purple crystals of the Voidreach.

pickaxes.name: Mythril Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: Breaks obsidian in the Ashlands (stone and essence).

pickaxes.name: Adamant Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: Mines iron ore veins for scrap, and brings in 25% more of everything.

pickaxes.name: Starforged Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: Cracks starstone in the Voidreach (essence, sometimes a Star Shard). 50% more of everything, and the fastest swing.

structures.name: Stone Wall
structures.desc: Sturdy wall that holds much longer.

structures.name: Gate
structures.desc: You walk through it. Enemies can't.

structures.name: Arrow Turret
structures.desc: Shoots arrows at enemies in range.

structures.name: Flame Turret
structures.desc: Hurls fire that sets enemies ablaze.

structures.name: Spike Trap
structures.desc: Hurts enemies that walk over it. Safe for you.

structures.name: Banner
structures.desc: Shows everyone whose camp this is.

boats.name: Log Raft
boats.desc: Floats on lakes and shallow coastal water. Too flimsy for the open sea.

boats.name: Sailing Sloop
boats.desc: A real sail: crosses deep, open sea to far islands.

boats.name: War Galleon
boats.desc: Fast, and its armoured hull takes 40% of the damage you'd take at sea.

species.name: Mossling
species.desc: Loves chopping trees and breaking rocks, and brings you every log. A timid fighter.

species.name: Emberpup
species.desc: A fierce little fire hound. Its bites burn, and it never leaves your side in a fight.

species.name: Glimmerfox
species.desc: Zaps enemies with lightning from afar and happily helps with the chores.

bosses.name: Inferno Titan
bosses.tip: Meteors fall where you stand, and its charge leaves the ground burning.

bosses.name: Frost Warden
bosses.tip: Its frost breath sweeps a cone, ice spikes run out in lines, and a ring of ice closes in: find the gap.

bosses.name: Storm Colossus
bosses.tip: Lightning strikes where you are: keep moving. Static orbs circle it.

bosses.name: Void Herald
bosses.tip: It hides among mirror images and opens singularities that drag you in.

bosses.name: Bone King
bosses.tip: It raises the dead around you and hurls fans of bone. Its curses burst a moment after they mark the ground.

bosses.name: Thornmother
bosses.tip: Roots burst from the ground towards you and spore clouds poison the air. She burrows away and roots again elsewhere.

bosses.name: Sand Wyrm
bosses.tip: It dives under the sand and bursts up beneath you: run from the rumbling circle. Quakes ripple outward in rings.

bosses.name: Tide Leviathan
bosses.tip: Walls of water sweep across the island: find the gap. Geysers burst under your feet and whirlpools drag you in.
